attributes.name: Improvised Boulder
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, bury this card to use your Strength skill + 2d12. If this is not the first combat check of your turn, add 3d12 instead. After playing this card, you may succeed at a Strength or Survival 12 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.

When you defeat a barrier that has the Lock, Obstacle, or Trap trait, reveal this card to draw a weapon, an armor, or an item from your discard pile.
